units.title: 求师·凡求师傅先究文章（文书既父母，父爻为书籍、为学馆、为学分）；用居弱地不范不模、若在旺乡可矜可式（有尊卑名分者不看应爻，门人投师以父母爻为师长）

rule.yi: 求老师先看文章（父母爻）：父母爻代表书籍、学馆和老师的学问。老师没有尊卑称呼的，以应爻为用神；有尊卑名分的，不看应爻，按名分论；学生占投师，不论老少，都以父母爻为师长。用神休囚，老师畏缩拘束，不能做楷模；旺相有气，魁梧雄伟，可敬可学。
rule.en: In seeking a teacher look first to the writing (the Resource line): the Resource line stands for the books, the school and the teacher's learning. If the teacher has no title of seniority, the Other line is the Subject; if he has a rank of seniority, the Other line is not looked at and one judges by the rank; when a pupil divines about taking a teacher, whether he is old or young the Resource line is the teacher. If the Subject is resting and trapped the teacher is timid and cramped and cannot be a model; if thriving and having breath he is tall and imposing and worthy of respect and imitation.

yi: 出钱出饭、供养先生，
教养固然依靠严厉的师长，
明白善道、恢复本性，
启发全靠先觉的人。
凡是求师傅，
先要看文章（父母爻）
en: Giving money and meals to keep a teacher,
the bringing up depends on a strict master,
while to understand the good and return to one's first nature,
one relies wholly on one who has awakened first.
In seeking a teacher,
first look to the writing (the Resource line)

zh: 文书既父母，父爻为书籍，为学馆，为学分。
yi: 文书就是父母爻，父爻代表书籍、学馆、学问的分量。
en: The documents are the Resource line; the Resource line stands for books, the school and the weight of one's learning.

yi: 用神落在弱地，
必定不能做范做模（榜样）；
如果在旺乡，
就可敬可效法
en: If the Subject is in a weak place,
he is no pattern and no model;
if it is in a strong place,
he is worthy of respect and of imitation

zh: 所请之师，无尊卑称呼者，以应爻为用神也，如有尊卑名分，不可看应爻，当以名分论之。
如门人卜投师，不论老幼，皆以父母爻为师长。
如用神休囚，其师必然畏惧局促，不能为人之模范；
旺相有气，则魁梧雄伟，堪为学者矜式仪矣。
yi: 所请的老师，没有尊卑称呼的，以应爻为用神；如果有尊卑名分，不可以看应爻，要按名分来论。
如果是学生占投拜老师，不论老少，都以父母爻为师长。
如果用神休囚，那位老师必定畏缩拘束，不能做别人的模范；
旺相有气，就魁梧雄伟，足以做学者敬重效法的仪范。
en: For the teacher engaged, if there is no title of seniority, the Other line is taken as the Subject; if there is a rank of seniority, the Other line is not to be looked at, and one judges by the rank.
If a pupil divines about taking a teacher, whether old or young, the Resource line is taken as the teacher.
If the Subject is resting and trapped, the teacher is surely timid and cramped, and cannot be a model for others;
if it is thriving and has breath, he is tall and imposing and fit to be a pattern respected and followed by scholars.

note.yi: 「应爻为用神」和「父母爻为师长」看起来是两种取法，书里的注把分界讲了：老师和你之间没有尊卑名分（比如请来的先生），看应爻；已经有师生名分、你去拜师，看父母爻。「学分」书里没有解释，从后面「学分欠通」（LY.EXAM.HJC.07）看是学问、学识的意思。
note.en: The two ways of fixing the Subject, the Other line and the Resource line, are separated by the commentary: where there is no rank of seniority between you and the man (such as a teacher you hire), look at the Other; where the teacher-pupil standing already exists and you go to take him as teacher, look at the Resource line. "The weight of learning" is not explained, but from "his learning is deficient" later (LY.EXAM.HJC.07) it means learning and scholarship.

units.title: 求师·临刑临害好施夏楚之威（带刑害白虎则师性暴少慈好笞挞）；逢岁逢身业擅束修之养（用爻卦身持太岁则专以严训为业、务得束修养家）

rule.yi: 用爻临刑、临害，老师爱用戒尺显威，带着刑害白虎的，性情暴躁少慈，必定爱打人，旺而动更甚；用爻逢太岁、逢卦身，老师以严格训导为业，一定要拿到束修来养家。
rule.en: If the Subject line stands on punishment or harm, the teacher loves to show his severity with the rod, and one carrying punishment, harm and the White Tiger is violent and short of kindness and surely loves to flog, the more so if strong and moving; if the Subject line meets Tai Sui or the Body, the teacher makes strict instruction his trade and must have the tuition fee to keep his family.

yi: （用神）临刑、临害，
爱施行夏楚（戒尺）的威严
en: If the Subject stands on punishment or harm,
he loves to display the severity of the rod

zh: 夏楚，儆顽杖也，若带刑害白虎，其师性暴少慈，必好笞挞，旺动尤甚。
yi: 夏楚是用来警戒顽童的戒杖；如果（用爻）带着刑、害、白虎，那老师性情暴躁少慈，一定爱打人，旺而发动就更厉害。
en: The xiachu is the rod for warning unruly boys; if the line carries punishment, harm or the White Tiger, the teacher is violent and short of kindness and surely loves to flog, the more so if it is strong and moving.

yi: （用爻）逢太岁、逢卦身，
以收束修养家为业
en: If the Subject meets Tai Sui or the Body,
his trade is the tuition fee that keeps his family

zh: 用爻卦身或持太岁，其师专以严训为业，务得束修以养家者。
yi: 用爻、卦身或持太岁，这位老师专以严格训导为业，一定要拿到束修来养家。
en: If the Subject line, the Body or Tai Sui is held, the teacher makes strict instruction his trade and must have the tuition fee to keep his family.

note.yi: 「夏楚」是「夏」和「楚」两种惩治学生的木条（楚是荆条）；「束修」是学生交给老师的学费（古时十条干肉为一束）。「逢岁逢身」的「岁」是太岁，「身」是卦身。
note.en: The "xia and chu" are the two kinds of rod used to punish pupils (chu is the thorn switch); the "tuition fee" is what pupils pay the teacher (anciently a bundle of ten strips of dried meat). The "year" in "meeting the year or the Body" is Tai Sui and the "body" is the hexagram Body.

units.title: 求师·兑金震巽杂学堪推、离火乾坤专经可断：父母爻落震巽艮坎兑五卦为杂学，落离乾坤三宫为专经

rule.yi: 推断老师是专治一经还是学问杂：父母爻落在震、巽、艮、坎、兑五卦里的，是杂学；落在离、乾、坤三宫里的，是专经。
rule.en: To judge whether a teacher specialises in one classic or has a miscellaneous learning: a Resource line in the five trigrams Zhen, Xun, Gen, Kan and Dui means miscellaneous learning; in the three palaces Li, Qian and Kun it means a single classic.

yi: 兑金、震巽（落在这些卦里），
可以推断他学的是杂学；
离火、乾、坤，
可以断定他专治一经
en: Dui Metal, Zhen and Xun:
one may infer a miscellaneous learning;
Li Fire, Qian and Kun:
one may judge a specialist in a single classic

zh: 凡推师之专经杂学者，当以父母在震、巽、艮、坎、兑五卦为杂学，离、乾、坤三宫为专经。
yi: 凡是推断老师是专治一经还是杂学的，应当以父母爻落在震、巽、艮、坎、兑五卦的为杂学，落在离、乾、坤三宫的为专经。
en: In judging whether a teacher is a specialist in one classic or of miscellaneous learning, take the Resource line in the five trigrams Zhen, Xun, Gen, Kan and Dui as miscellaneous learning, and in the three palaces Li, Qian and Kun as a single classic.

note.yi: 经文只点了兑、震巽、离、乾坤，注把它补全成五卦（震巽艮坎兑）对三宫（离乾坤）。「专经」是一生专治一部经，「杂学」是各样学问都涉及。
note.en: The verse names only Dui, Zhen-Xun, Li and Qian-Kun, and the commentary fills it out into five trigrams (Zhen, Xun, Gen, Kan, Dui) against three palaces (Li, Qian, Kun). A "single classic" is a lifelong specialisation in one classic and "miscellaneous learning" is a spread across many kinds of learning.

units.title: 求师·本象同乡在内则离家不远、他宫异地在外则隔属须遥（用象在本宫居外卦本处人而住远，在他宫居内卦外郡人而住近）；与世相生非亲则友（与世爻生合有亲道，不同宫者相识朋友）

rule.yi: 老师是哪里的人、住得远近：用神在本宫，是同乡，在内卦离家不远；在别宫，是异地人，在外卦就隔得很远；注补充：本宫而居外卦是本地人但住得远，他宫而居内卦是外郡人却住得近。用神和世相生，不是亲戚就是朋友：与世爻生合有亲谊，不同宫的是相识的朋友。
rule.en: Where the teacher is from and how far he lives: the Subject in its own palace means a fellow villager, and in the inner trigram he lives not far from home; in another palace he is from another place, and in the outer trigram he lives across a jurisdiction and far away; the commentary adds that in its own palace but in the outer trigram he is a local man who lives far, and in another palace but in the inner trigram he is from another prefecture but lives near. If the Subject and the Self give each other life he is a relative or a friend: giving life to or combining with the Self means kinship, and of a different palace an acquaintance and friend.

yi: （用神）在本宫，是同乡人，
在内卦就离家不远；
在别的宫，是异地人，
在外卦就隔着辖区、相当远。
en: In its own palace, he is from the same village;
in the inner trigram he lives not far from home;
in another palace, he is from another place;
in the outer trigram he lives across a jurisdiction and far away.

zh: 用象在本宫而居外卦，是本处人，其住居必远；
在他宫而居内卦，是外郡人，其居住却近也。
yi: 用象在本宫但在外卦，是本地人，他的住处一定远；
在别的宫而在内卦，是外郡的人，他的住处却近。
en: If the Subject is in its own palace but in the outer trigram, he is a local man, and his home is surely far;
if in another palace but in the inner trigram, he is from another prefecture, and his home is near.

yi: （用神）和世相生，
不是亲戚就是朋友
en: If it gives life to the Self,
he is a relative or a friend

zh: 若与世爻不同宫者，是相识朋友。
yi: 和世爻生合，一定有亲戚关系；
如果和世爻不同宫，是相识的朋友。
en: If it gives life to or combines with the Self, there is surely kinship;
if it is not of the same palace as the Self, he is an acquaintance and friend.

note.yi: 「隔属」是隔着一个行政辖区（府、县）。注讲的是经文的两种交叉情形，和经文一起看就是四种：本宫内卦（同乡近）、他宫外卦（异地远）、本宫外卦（同乡但住远）、他宫内卦（异乡但住近）。
note.en: A "jurisdiction" is an administrative district (a prefecture or county). The commentary gives the two crossed cases of the verse, which together make four: own palace and inner trigram (fellow villager, near), other palace and outer trigram (from elsewhere, far), own palace and outer trigram (fellow villager but lives far), other palace and inner trigram (from elsewhere but lives near).

units.title: 求师·与官交变不贵亦乐：用神化官爻则老师异日必贵，带白虎刑害则有病之人，持月建加青龙必有前程

rule.yi: 用神变出官爻，这位老师日后必定显贵；带着白虎、刑、害，就是有病的人；持月建又加青龙，必有好前程。
rule.en: If the Subject changes into the Pressure line the teacher will in time surely become eminent; if it carries the White Tiger, punishment or harm he is a sick man; if it holds the Month and has the Azure Dragon besides, he surely has a career before him.

yi: （用神）变出官爻，
就算不显贵也快乐
en: If it changes into the official star,
then if not eminent, at least he is content

zh: 用化官爻，其师异日必贵；
如白虎带刑害，则是有病之人；
如持月建更加青龙，必有前程在身。
yi: 用神变出官爻，这位老师日后必定显贵；
如果带着白虎、刑、害，就是有病的人；
如果持月建又加青龙，必定前程在身。
en: If the Subject changes into the Pressure line, the teacher will in time surely become eminent;
if it carries the White Tiger, punishment or harm, he is a sick man;
if it holds the Month and the Azure Dragon besides, he surely has a career ahead of him.

units.title: 求师·静合福爻喜遇循循之善诱、动加龙德怕逢凛凛之威严：用神与子孙作合最吉，师徒契合；父动克子孙加白虎刑害则师严毅方正难为子弟

rule.yi: 用神静而和子孙爻相合最吉，老师博文约礼、循循善诱，师徒投契；怕父爻动而克子孙，再加白虎、刑、害，老师就严厉刚毅、凛然不可犯，子弟难受。
rule.en: The Subject still and combining with the Output line is most auspicious: the teacher is learned and restrained and draws one on step by step, and teacher and pupil are in accord; what is feared is the Resource line moving and controlling Output, with the White Tiger, punishment and harm besides, when the teacher is stern, resolute and so awesome that one dare not offend him, and the pupils fare hard.

yi: （用神）静而合福爻，
喜的是遇到循循善诱的老师；
动而加上龙德，
怕碰到凛然的威严
en: If it is still and combines with the Output line,
one is glad to meet a teacher who draws one on step by step;
if it moves and adds the Dragon Virtue,
one fears meeting a stern and awe-inspiring dignity

zh: 用神与子孙作合最吉，必能博文约礼，循循善诱，甚得为师之道，必主师徒契合。
唯怕父动则克子孙，更加白虎刑害，必然难为子弟，主其师严毅方正，凛然而不可少犯。
yi: 用神和子孙爻相合最吉，老师必定博文约礼、循循善诱，很得为师之道，主师徒契合。
只怕父爻动而克子孙，再加白虎、刑、害，必然让子弟难受，主这位老师严厉刚毅、方正，凛然不可稍有触犯。
en: The Subject combining with the Output line is most auspicious: the teacher will surely be learned and restrained and draw one on step by step, has much of the way of a teacher, and teacher and pupil are in accord.

What is feared is the Resource line moving and controlling Output, with the White Tiger, punishment and harm besides: it surely makes things hard for the pupils, and means the teacher is stern, resolute and upright, so awesome that one dare not offend him in the least.

note.yi: 「龙德」是神煞里的龙德星（书里没有在这里解释），「博文约礼」出自《论语》，「循循善诱」是一步一步引导。
note.en: The "Dragon Virtue" is the Dragon Virtue spirit-star (the book does not explain it here); "learned and restrained" comes from the Analects, and "draws one on step by step" is leading a pupil on gradually.

units.title: 求师·父入墓中边孝先爱眠懒读（父爻入墓则师爱安逸、赖于教训、学分欠通，逢空化墓皆然；日辰冲破墓爻又主聪察）；文临身上李老聃博古通今（六爻无父必欠学问，静临卦身或居生旺之地才学非常）

rule.yi: 父爻入墓，老师爱安逸、懒于教训、学问欠通达，逢空、化墓也一样，日辰冲破墓爻则又聪明明察；文章（父爻）临在身上，老师博古通今；六爻里没有父爻，一定欠缺学问，静而临卦身或居生旺之地，才学非常。
rule.en: If the Resource line enters the tomb, the teacher loves ease, is lazy at teaching and admonishing and has deficient learning, and the same if it meets Void or changes into the tomb, though if the Day clashes and breaks the tomb line he is again sharp and observant; if the writing (the Resource line) stands on the Body, the teacher is learned in antiquity and versed in the present; if there is no Resource line among the six lines he surely lacks learning, and if it is still and stands on the Body or in a place of life or strength his talent and learning are extraordinary.

yi: 父爻入墓，
（老师）像边孝先，爱睡觉、懒读书
en: If the Resource line enters the tomb,
he is like Bian Xiaoxian, fond of sleeping and lazy at reading

zh: 父爻入墓，其师唯爱安逸，赖于教训，学分欠通，逢空化墓皆然。
若日辰冲破墓爻，又主聪察。
yi: 父爻入墓，这位老师只爱安逸，懒于教导训诫，学问欠通达，遇空、变墓也都是这样。
如果日辰冲破墓爻，又主聪明明察。
en: If the Resource line enters the tomb, the teacher loves only ease, is lazy about teaching and admonishing, and his learning is deficient; the same holds if it meets Void or changes into the tomb.
If the Day clashes and breaks the tomb line, he is again sharp and observant.

yi: 文章（父爻）临在身上，
（老师）像李老聃，博古通今
en: If the writing stands on the Body,
he is like Lao Dan, learned in antiquity and versed in the present

zh: 凡求师，以父为师之才学，六爻无父必欠学问，若得静临卦身或居生旺之地，其师才学非常。
yi: 凡是求师，以父爻代表老师的才学，六爻里没有父爻，一定欠缺学问；如果静而临在卦身上，或者处在生旺之地，这位老师才学非同寻常。
en: In seeking a teacher, the Resource line stands for the teacher's talent and learning; if there is no Resource line among the six lines, he surely lacks learning; if it is still and stands on the Body, or is in a place of life or strength, the teacher's talent and learning are extraordinary.

note.yi: 边孝先是汉代的边韶，据说白天睡觉，弟子笑他「边孝先，腹便便，懒读书，但欲眠」，他答「腹便便，五经笥，但欲眠，思经事」；李老聃是老子。书里只提名字作比喻，没有讲故事。
note.en: Bian Xiaoxian is Bian Shao of the Han, said to have napped by day, so that his disciples mocked him, "Bian Xiaoxian, big belly, lazy at reading, only wants to sleep"; Lao Dan is Laozi. The book uses the names only as comparisons and does not tell the stories.

units.title: 求师·母化子孙必主能诗能赋（父化福善作杂文，带刑害病败虽能作文多破绽，子带月建加青龙出口成章）；鬼连兄煞定然多诈多奸（兄动化鬼、鬼动化兄皆奸诈）；口是心非临空亡而发动（用爻宜静不宜动、宜旺不宜空）

rule.yi: 父爻化子孙，老师能诗能赋、善作杂文，带刑害病败的文章多破绽，子孙带月建加青龙则出口成章；兄动化鬼、鬼动化兄，老师多诈多奸，刑克世爻有是非口舌；用爻临空亡而发动，口是心非：动而空不诚实，静而空懒教训，化空也一样。
rule.en: If the Resource line changes into Output the teacher can write poems and rhapsodies and is good at miscellaneous prose, though if it carries punishment, harm, sickness or decay his writing is full of flaws, and if Output carries the Month and the Azure Dragon he speaks in finished prose; if Peer moves and changes into Pressure, or Pressure moves and changes into Peer, the teacher is deceitful and cunning, and punishing and controlling the Self means quarrels and gossip; if the Subject line stands on Void and moves, he says one thing and means another: moving and Void is insincere, still and Void is lazy at teaching, and the same if it changes into Void.

yi: 父母爻化出子孙，
必定能作诗、能写赋
en: If Resource changes into Output,
he will be able to write both poems and rhapsodies

zh: 带刑害病败等爻，虽能作文，必多破绽。
子带月建又加青龙，必然出口成章；
与父作合，其师或有小儿带来。
yi: 父爻变福神，这位老师擅长写杂文；
带着刑、害、病、败等爻，虽然能作文，文章必定多破绽。
子孙带着月建又加青龙，必定出口成章；
和父爻相合，这位老师或许带着小孩来。
en: If Resource changes into the spirit of blessing, the teacher is good at miscellaneous prose;
if it carries lines of punishment, harm, sickness or decay, then though he can write, his writing will surely be full of flaws;
if Output carries the Month and the Azure Dragon, he will surely speak in finished prose;
if it combines with the Resource line, the teacher may bring a small child along.

yi: 官鬼连着兄弟煞，
一定多诈多奸
en: If Pressure joins the Peer baleful line,
he is surely full of deceit and cunning

zh: 凡遇兄动化鬼，鬼动化兄，皆主奸诈；
刑克世爻，必有是非口舌。
yi: 凡是遇到兄弟动化官鬼、官鬼动化兄弟，都主奸诈；
刑克世爻，一定有是非口舌。
en: Whenever Peer moves and changes into Pressure or Pressure moves and changes into Peer, it means deceit and cunning;
if it punishes and controls the Self, there will surely be quarrels and gossip.

yi: 嘴上说的和心里想的不一样，
是用爻临空亡而发动
en: He says one thing and means another,
when the Subject line stands on Void and moves

zh: 用爻宜静不宜动，宜旺不宜空，动空不诚实，静空懒教训，化空亦然。
yi: 用爻宜静不宜动，宜旺不宜空；动而空的不诚实，静而空的懒于教训，变空也是这样。
en: The Subject line should be still and not moving, strong and not Void; moving and Void means he is not sincere, still and Void means he is lazy at instruction, and the same if it changes into Void.

note.yi: 「福」是福神（子孙爻）。「小儿带来」是老师带着自己的小孩一起来。
note.en: The "spirit of blessing" is the Output line. "Bring a small child along" means the teacher brings his own young child with him.

units.title: 求师·彼迁此请持世应而兴隆（世应俱动主有家延请，两爻俱空俱不成）；母值应而世生须知假馆（父临应上世动来生合，必馆他家而欲附学）；父在外而福合必是担囊（自占以世为徒、不看福爻，父兄占以子弟为徒、不看世爻；父在外卦他宫安静而子孙动去相会则游学他方）

rule.yi: 世、应都动，有人家来聘请；两爻都空，都不成。父爻临在应爻上、世爻动来生合它，老师在别人家设馆，自己想去附学。自己占以世爻为徒、不看福爻，父兄代占以子弟为徒、不看世爻；父爻在外卦又是别宫、安静，而子孙动去相会，必是到别处游学。
rule.en: If the Self and Other both move, some household will engage him; if both lines are Void, neither comes about. If the Resource line stands on the Other and the Self moves to give life to or combine with it, the teacher keeps his school at another's house and one wishes to attach oneself to it. When one divines for oneself the Self is the pupil and the Output line is not looked at; when a father or elder brother divines for him the son or younger brother is the pupil and the Self line is not looked at; if the Resource line is in the outer trigram, of another palace and still, and Output moves to meet it, he will surely go to study in another place.

yi: 他那边迁走、我这边来请，
（用神）持世应而兴旺
en: He moves on there and is invited here,
when the Subject holds the Self or the Other and flourishes

zh: 世应俱动，主有家延请，两爻俱空，必然俱不能成。
yi: 世应都动，主有人家来聘请；两爻都空，必定都不能成。
en: If the Self and Other both move, some household will engage him; if both lines are Void, neither will come about.

yi: 父母爻在应爻上而世爻来生它，
要知道是借别人的馆（附学）
en: If the Resource line is on the Other and the Self gives it life,
know that it means borrowing another's school (to study there)

zh: 父临应上，而世爻动来生合者，必馆于他家，而欲附学也。
yi: 父爻临在应爻上，而世爻动来生合它的，一定是在别人家设馆，而自己想去附学。
en: If the Resource line is on the Other and the Self moves to give life to or combine with it, he surely keeps his school at another's house, and one wishes to attach oneself to the study.

yi: 父爻在外卦而和福神相合，
一定是挑着行囊（出外游学）
en: If the Resource line is in the outer trigram and combines with Output,
it surely means carrying one's bag (going abroad to study)

zh: 凡卜求师，若子弟自占，以世为徒，不看福爻；
父兄来占，以子弟为徒，不看世爻。
若父在外卦，又系他宫，安静而子孙动去相会，必游学他方，担囊从事也。
yi: 凡是占求师，如果是子弟自己占，以世爻为徒弟，不看福爻；
如果是父兄来占，以子弟为徒弟，不看世爻。
如果父爻在外卦，又是别宫，安静，而子孙动去与它相会，一定是到别处游学，担着行囊从师。
en: In divining for a teacher, if the pupil divines for himself, the Self is the pupil and the Output line is not looked at;
if a father or elder brother divines, the son or younger brother is the pupil, and the Self line is not looked at.

If the Resource line is in the outer trigram and belongs to another palace and is still, while Output moves to meet it, he will surely go to study in another place, carrying his bag to serve a teacher.

note.yi: 「假馆」是借别人的馆舍；「担囊」是挑着行李出门游学。「福爻」是子孙爻（福神）。
note.en: "Borrowing a school" is using another man's school premises; "carrying one's bag" is setting out with one's luggage to study abroad. The "Output line" here is the line of blessing, Output.

units.title: 求师·鬼化文书克世则讼由乎学（鬼动化父母刑克世爻异日必争论，父化鬼爻或官爻皆动伤世亦然）

rule.yi: 官鬼变出文书（父母）来克世，会因学业上的事引出官司；官鬼动变父母刑克世爻，日后一定有争论；父爻变官鬼，或官爻都动来伤世，也一样。
rule.en: If Pressure changes into the document line and controls the Self, a lawsuit will arise from the schooling; if the Pressure line moves and changes into Resource and punishes and controls the Self, there will surely be dispute in future; the same if the Resource line changes into the Pressure line, or the Pressure lines all move and harm the Self.

yi: 官鬼变出文书（父母）来克世，
就会因学业而起官司
en: If Pressure turns into the document line and controls the Self,
a lawsuit arises from the schooling

zh: 鬼动若化出父母刑克世爻，异日必主争论；
父化鬼爻，或官爻皆动有伤世者，亦然。
yi: 官鬼动，如果变出父母爻刑克世爻，日后一定有争论；
父爻变官鬼爻，或者官爻都动而伤世的，也一样。
en: If Pressure moves and changes into the Resource line and punishes and controls the Self, there will surely be dispute in future;
the same if the Resource line changes into the Pressure line, or the Pressure lines all move and harm the Self.

units.title: 求师·月扶福德日生则青出于蓝：子孙有气不空又得月日动爻生合则学有进益，用爻反衰则弟子胜于师

rule.yi: 月建扶着子孙、日辰生它，学生青出于蓝：子孙爻要有气不空，又得月、日、动爻生合，学业才有进益；用爻反而衰，弟子反而胜过老师。
rule.en: If the Month supports Output and the Day gives it life, the pupil surpasses the master: the Output line must have breath and not be Void and be given life and combination by the Month, the Day or a moving line before study makes progress; if the Subject line is on the contrary weak, the pupil surpasses the teacher.

yi: 月建扶着福德（子孙）、日辰生它，
就会青出于蓝
en: If the Month supports Output and the Day gives it life,
the pupil will surpass the master

zh: 须得子孙有气不空，又遇月日动爻生合，则学有进益；
若用爻反衰，则弟子反胜于师，如青出于蓝也。
yi: 必须子孙爻有气、不空，又遇到月、日、动爻生合，学业才有进益；
如果用爻反而衰，那么弟子反而胜过老师，就像青出于蓝。
en: The Output line must have breath and not be Void, and also meet life and combination from the Month, the Day or a moving line, and then study makes progress;
if the Subject line is on the contrary weak, the pupil surpasses the teacher, like blue coming from indigo.

units.title: 求师·刑克同伤父子必罹其害、合生为助官鬼莫受其扶（父为子延师以世为自、子孙为儿、应为师；世与子孙皆受刑克日后父子遭害，官爻动来刑克世与子孙不可又加财动生合助之）

rule.yi: 父亲为儿子请老师，世爻是自己、子孙爻是儿子、应爻是老师：世和子孙都受刑克，日后父子都要遭害；官爻动来刑克世爻和子孙，不可再有财爻动来生合帮它。
rule.en: When a father engages a teacher to instruct his son, the Self is himself, the Output line the son and the Other the teacher: if the Self and Output are both punished and controlled, father and son will suffer harm later; if the Pressure line moves to punish and control the Self and Output, Wealth must not also move to give it life and combine and help it.

yi: 刑克一起伤到父子，
必定遭到它的害。
（财爻）合生是为了帮助官鬼，
不要接受它的扶助
en: If punishment and control injure father and son together,
they will surely suffer harm from it.
if combination and life-giving help Pressure,
do not accept its support

zh: 父卜延师训子，以世为自，以子孙为儿，以应为师。
如世与子孙皆受刑克，日后父子必遭其害。
如官爻动来刑克世爻子孙，不可又加财动生合助之。
yi: 父亲占请老师教训儿子，以世爻为自己，以子孙爻为儿子，以应爻为老师。
如果世爻和子孙都受刑克，日后父子一定遭受它的害。
如果官爻动来刑克世爻和子孙，不可以再有财爻动来生合帮助它。
en: When a father divines about engaging a teacher to instruct his son, the Self is himself, the Output line is the son, and the Other is the teacher.
If the Self and Output are both punished and controlled, father and son will surely suffer harm from it later.
If the Pressure line moves to punish and control the Self and Output, Wealth must not also move to give it life and combine and help it.

units.title: 求师·或击或冲父母逢之不久（父母要有气而不宜动变，动变伤克子孙必不能久）；或空或陷世身见之不成（世、应、身爻空亡冲克皆难成）

rule.yi: 父母爻被击被冲，老师做不长久：父母爻要有气，但不宜动变，动变就伤克子孙，必不能久；世爻、卦身遇空或陷，事不成：世、应、身爻空亡、被冲克，都是难成的象。
rule.en: If the Resource line is struck or clashed the teacher does not last: the Resource line must have breath but should not move or change, for moving or changing it harms and controls Output and it cannot last; if the Self or the Body meets Void or sinks, it does not come about: the Self, the Other and the Body line being Void, clashed or controlled are all signs of difficulty.

yi: （父母爻）或被击或被冲，
父母爻遇到这个就不会长久
en: Whether struck or clashed,
the Resource line that meets it will not last

zh: 父母虽要有气，然不宜动变，动变则伤克子孙，必不能久。
yi: 父母爻虽然要有气，但不宜动变，动变就伤克子孙，一定不能长久。
en: The Resource line must have breath, but should not move or change; if it moves or changes it harms and controls Output, and it surely cannot last.

yi: （世身）或空或陷，
世爻、卦身遇到这个就不成
en: Whether Void or sunk,
the Self or Body that meets it will not succeed

zh: 世应身爻空亡冲克，皆见难成之象。
yi: 世爻、应爻、卦身爻空亡、被冲克，都是难成的象。
en: The Self, the Other and the Body line being Void, clashed or controlled are all signs of difficulty in succeeding.

units.title: 求师·财化父爻妻族荐之于不日（有父母而本宫财爻化出一重则妻家荐师，兄弟化出则朋友荐；动爻是重已荐过、是交将荐来）；母藏福德僧家设帐于先年（父爻伏子孙下师前年设帐于僧房道观，伏世下乃旧师）

rule.yi: 财爻化出父爻，妻家的亲族不久会推荐老师：卦有父母、本宫财爻化出一「重」，妻家就再荐一位老师；兄弟爻化出，是朋友来荐；动爻是「重」的已经荐过，是「交」的将要荐来。父爻伏在子孙爻下，老师前年在僧房道观设馆；伏在世爻下，是旧时的老师。
rule.en: If Wealth changes into the Resource line the wife's kin will soon recommend a teacher: if the hexagram has a Resource line and a Wealth line of the home palace changes out one "chong", the wife's family will recommend another teacher, and if Peer changes out, a friend recommends one; if the moving line is a "chong" the recommendation has already been made, and if a "jiao" it is about to be made. If the Resource line lies hidden under Output, the teacher kept his school the year before last in a monks' cell or Taoist temple; if it lies hidden under the Self, he is a former teacher.

yi: 财爻化出父爻，
妻家的亲族不久就会推荐（一位老师）
en: If Wealth changes into the Resource line,
the wife's kin will soon recommend one

zh: 若卦有父母，遇本宫财爻有化出一重者，不日间妻家又荐一师来也；
yi: 如果卦里有父母爻，而本宫的财爻有变出一个「重」的，不几天妻家又会推荐一位老师来；
兄弟爻化出的，就是朋友来推荐。
动爻是重的，已经推荐过了；
动爻是交的，将要推荐来。
en: If the hexagram has a Resource line and the Wealth line of the home palace changes out a "chong" (an old-yang moving line), within a few days the wife's family will recommend another teacher;
if it is Peer that changes out, a friend recommends one.
if the moving line is a "chong", the recommendation has already been made;
if it is a "jiao" (an old-yin moving line), it is about to be made.

yi: 父母爻伏藏在福德（子孙）爻下，
（这位老师）前几年在僧家设馆
en: If the Resource line lies hidden under Output,
the teacher kept his school at a monk's house in an earlier year

zh: 如父爻伏在子孙爻下，其师必前年设帐于僧房道观；
yi: 如果父爻伏在子孙爻下，这位老师一定前年在僧房道观里设馆；
父爻伏在世爻下，是旧时的老师。
en: If the Resource line lies hidden under the Output line, the teacher surely kept his school the year before last in a monks' cell or Taoist temple;
if the Resource line lies hidden under the Self, he is a former teacher.

note.yi: 「重」「交」是起卦里的两种动爻：重是老阳（三个正面），交是老阴（三个反面）；「设帐」是开设私塾；「本宫财爻」是和卦同宫的财爻。书里没有说「化出一重」具体怎么看，这里按字面译。
note.en: "Chong" and "jiao" are the two kinds of moving line in casting: chong is the old yang (three heads) and jiao the old yin (three tails); "setting up the curtain" is opening a private school; the "Wealth line of the home palace" is the Wealth line of the same palace as the hexagram. The book does not say exactly how "changes out one chong" is read, and it is translated as written.

units.title: 求师·搜索六爻无过求理、思量万事莫贵读书：求师不专指道学之师，百工技艺拜僧道为师皆是；自占以世爻看学者，隔手来占须问是何人；师弟相生相合则吉相冲相克则凶

rule.yi: 求师不只指讲道学的老师，学百工技艺、拜僧人道士为师也都是；自己占，以世爻看学习的人；别人代占，要问是什么人，朋友兄弟就以兄弟爻为主；总要师弟相生相合才吉，相冲相克就凶。
rule.en: Seeking a teacher does not mean only a teacher of moral learning: learning a craft or skill, or taking a monk or Taoist as teacher, all count; when one divines for oneself, the learner is read from the Self line; when another divines on one's behalf one must ask who he is, and for a friend or brother Peer is the main line; in every case teacher and pupil giving life to and combining with each other is auspicious, and clashing and controlling each other inauspicious.

yi: 搜寻六爻（的道理），
不过是求得其中的理；
思量万事，
没有比读书更可贵的
en: Search the six lines,
it is no more than seeking the principle in them;
ponder all affairs,
and nothing is more precious than study

zh: 凡求师，不可专指道学之师，如欲投学百工技艺及拜僧道为师类皆是。
但师之主象，自占不以父母；
而学者主象，自占当以世爻看之。
如隔手来占，须问是何人，如朋友兄弟则以兄弟为主之类。
皆要师弟相生相合则吉，相冲相克则凶。
yi: 凡是求师，不能只指讲道学的老师，想拜师学百工技艺以及拜僧人道士为师的，也都属于求师。
但是老师的主象，自己占时不用父母爻；
而学习者的主象，自己占时要用世爻来看。
如果是别人代占，必须问是什么人，比如朋友、兄弟就以兄弟爻为主，等等。
都要老师和弟子相生相合才吉，相冲相克就凶。
en: In seeking a teacher, one must not mean only a teacher of moral philosophy; wanting to learn a craft or skill, or taking a monk or Taoist as teacher, all count.
But the main image of the teacher, when one divines for oneself, is not the Resource line;
and the main image of the learner, when one divines for oneself, is to be read from the Self line.
If another person divines on one's behalf, one must ask who it is; for a friend or brother, Peer is the main line, and so on.
In every case, teacher and pupil giving life to and combining with each other is auspicious, and clashing and controlling each other is inauspicious.

note.yi: 这一段说「师之主象，自占不以父母」，和第一条注里「门人卜投师，不论老幼，皆以父母爻为师长」看上去不一致，书里没有解释；这里照字面译，不替它调和。可能的读法是：拜僧道百工为师时，老师不以父母爻取，而以应爻或别的爻取，但原文没有明说。
note.en: This passage says "the main image of the teacher, when one divines for oneself, is not the Resource line", which seems at odds with the first commentary, "when a pupil divines about taking a teacher, whether old or young, the Resource line is the teacher"; the book does not explain, and it is translated as written without reconciling them. One possible reading is that for teachers of crafts, monks and Taoists the teacher is not taken from the Resource line but from the Other or another line, but the text does not say so.
